privacy.title: Privacy Policy - Locotrip
privacy.intro: At Locotrip, we place great importance on protecting your personal data. This privacy policy informs you about how we collect, use and protect your data when you use our platform.
privacy.section1Title: Who is responsible for your data?
privacy.section1Text: Locotrip, SAS, is the data controller for personal data collected on the platform https://www.loco-trip.com.
privacy.section2Intro: We only collect data necessary for the proper functioning of the service:
privacy.section2Sub1Items: First name, last name • Email address • Password (encrypted) • Phone number if requested
privacy.section2Sub2Items: Bookings made (dates, places, experiences) • Messages exchanged with guides • Payment data (via secure provider – not stored directly by Locotrip) • Reviews or comments
privacy.section3Title: Why do we use your data?
privacy.section3Items: Create and manage your user account • Enable booking of experiences and connection with guides • Send confirmations and notifications related to bookings • Improve the service (anonymous usage analysis) • Respond to your support requests
privacy.section4Intro: We process your data on the following legal bases:
privacy.section4Items: Contract execution (booking management) • Consent (newsletter, marketing) • Legal obligation (invoicing) • Legitimate interest (security, platform improvement)
privacy.section5Title: Who do we share your data with?
privacy.section5Intro: Your data may be shared with:
privacy.section5Items: The local guides you book (first name, last name, phone number if necessary) • Our subcontractors (hosting, payment services, technical support) • Competent authorities
privacy.section5Note: We never sell your personal data.
privacy.section6Title: How long do we keep your data?
privacy.section6Item1: Inactive account: deletion after 3 years of inactivity
privacy.section6Item3: Marketing data: until withdrawal of consent
privacy.section7Items: Right to access your data • Right to rectification • Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten') • Right to restriction of processing • Right to object • Right to portability
privacy.section8Text: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or destruction.
privacy.section8Examples: Examples: password encryption, secure hosting, limited internal access.
privacy.section9Items: The proper functioning of the site (authentication, navigation) • Audience analysis (Google Analytics or equivalent)
privacy.section9Manage: You can manage your preferences via the cookie banner on your first visit.
privacy.section10Text: Locotrip reserves the right to modify this policy. In case of major changes, you will be informed by email or on your next login.
privacy.section11Text: If you believe your rights are not respected, you can contact the ICO: www.ico.org.uk

cookies.title: Cookie Policy and Settings
cookies.section1Text: A cookie is a small file placed on your device while browsing our site. It allows us to remember certain information such as your language, session or pages visited.
cookies.section2Sub1Text: Necessary for the proper functioning of the site (connection, security, language...)
cookies.section2Sub2Text: Allow analysis of site usage (e.g. Google Analytics)
cookies.section2Sub3Text: Used to offer you targeted advertising
cookies.section3Text: On your first visit, a banner offers you to accept or refuse all or part of the cookies. You can change your preferences at any time by clicking on 'Manage cookies' at the bottom of the page.
cookies.section4Text: Cookies are kept for a maximum period of 13 months, in accordance with the legislation.

terms.title: Terms of Use - Locotrip
terms.section1Text: Locotrip is a platform connecting travelers with local guides offering cultural, gastronomic or sports experiences. These Terms of Use govern the use of our site www.locotrip.com.
terms.section2Text: Access to the site is free, but booking an experience requires creating a personal account.
terms.section3Text: The user undertakes to provide accurate information. They are responsible for the confidentiality of their password.
terms.section4Text: Any booking constitutes a commitment. In case of cancellation, the specific refund conditions of the guide or experience apply.
terms.section5Items: Not disrupt the proper functioning of the platform • Respect guides and other users • Not post illegal or offensive content
terms.section6Text: Locotrip acts as an intermediary. Guides are solely responsible for the experiences they offer. Locotrip cannot be held responsible in case of problems on site.
terms.section7Text: All site content is the property of Locotrip and may not be copied without permission.
terms.section8Text: Locotrip may suspend or delete an account in case of non-compliance with these Terms of Use.
terms.section9Text: The Terms of Use may be modified at any time. Users will be notified of major changes.

help.title: Support & Help - Locotrip
help.intro: Welcome to the Locotrip help center. Find here all the information needed to book, manage your experiences or contact our team.
help.faq1Question: How do I book an experience?
help.faq1Answer: Log in to your account • Search for an experience or guide • Click 'Book' and follow the steps • Wait for guide confirmation
help.faq2Answer: Yes, go to 'My bookings'. Refund conditions depend on the cancellation delay. Check details in each experience listing.
help.faq3Answer: Yes, all payments are processed via Stripe. No banking data is stored by Locotrip.
help.faq4Question: I haven't received a response from the guide. What should I do?
help.faq4Answer: Guides have 48h to respond. After this delay, the request automatically expires. You can try booking another experience.
help.faq5Question: Can I speak directly with the guide?
help.faq5Answer: Yes, as soon as a booking is accepted, a secure chat opens in your 'My messages' space.
help.technicalIntro: Are you experiencing a bug, display error, or connection problem?
help.issueTitle: Problem with an experience or guide?
help.issueIntro: If you encountered a problem during an experience (delay, absence, inappropriate behavior...):
help.issueStep1: Go to My bookings > Report a problem
help.issueStep3: Our team will process your request within 72h maximum

about.title: Who are we?
about.intro2: : Travel to the heart of territories, meet those who bring them to life.
about.subIntro: At Locotrip, we believe that a successful trip is measured in emotions, encounters and unforgettable memories, much more than in kilometers traveled or monuments checked off a list. Tired of impersonal tourism and beaten paths? So are we. That's why we created a platform where curiosity meets local passion.
about.missionsSub: Our ambition is simple: to transform the way you travel. We want to give you the keys to discover the true soul of a destination, hand in hand with those who cherish and know it intimately: local guides. Whether they are storytellers, passionate artisans, nature lovers or gourmets, our guides are the promise of a true immersion.
about.value1Text: We favor real experiences, far from artifice. Each guide, each activity is chosen for its unique character and local anchoring.
about.value2Text: We encourage tourism that values local communities, respects the environment and promotes fair sharing economy.
about.value3Text: We are convinced that human connection is at the heart of a memorable trip. Locotrip is a bridge between your curiosity and the generosity of local knowledge.
about.value4Text: Our guides are not just companions. They are ambassadors of their territory, driven by the desire to share their love for their part of the country, their culture, their history.
about.howItWorksTitle: How does it work? It's simple!
about.forTravelersText: Explore a multitude of unique experiences offered by passionate local guides. Search by destination, by interest, consult guide profiles, read reviews, and book in a few clicks the adventure that suits you.
about.forGuidesText: At Locotrip, we believe that a successful trip is measured in emotions, encounters and unforgettable memories, much more than in kilometers traveled or monuments checked off a list. Tired of impersonal tourism and beaten paths? So are we. That's why we created a platform where curiosity meets local passion.
